blocked_by: source-diverse pressure candidates have not yet passed geometry preflight

public_gates: M1479 must run preflight-only with --candidate-step-column source_step
M1479 must not run replay train PPO promote use private holdout export corpus or change actor inputs
M1479 must report geometry rows selected rows clipping diversity source_group retention and duplicate pressure keys
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat preflight result as replay evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs preflight-only geometry validation on M1476 source-diverse pressure candidates
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: preflight smoke only; no replay, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if selected candidates collapse to one seed or capability pair
stop if candidate_step_column is not source_step
stop if replay training PPO promotion or corpus export starts
fallback_plan: route to bounded replay design if preflight passes
route to preflight result audit if geometry or diversity fails

allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up bounded replay design or preflight audit manifest
next_stage_criteria: geometry diversity and duplicate-key counts are recorded
